file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive benchmarking script for deduplication operations
key_components: create_test_files() - generates test files with configurable duplicates
main() - CLI argument parsing and execution
imports: Standard library: argparse, json, sys, tempfile, time, pathlib, typing

patterns_discovered.description: Script supports dry-run mode when deduplication modules cannot be imported, enabling testing without full dependencies
Separate, focused functions for each benchmark operation (hashing, indexing, detection) with consistent return signatures
All results formatted as JSON dictionaries for easy comparison and external analysis
Test file creation supports variable file counts, duplicate ratios, and directory distribution
Uses time.perf_counter() for high-resolution timing measurements of each operation stage
Support for running benchmarks at multiple file counts (1000, 10000, 50000) in single execution

gotchas_discovered.description: Script gracefully handles import failures by checking if modules are None before use, preventing AttributeError crashes
gotchas_discovered.impact: Allows dry-run mode testing without full dependency chain installed

gotchas_discovered.description: Input validation required to prevent invalid floating-point values for duplicate_ratio parameter
gotchas_discovered.impact: Prevents nonsensical benchmark configurations (e.g., -0.5 or 1.5 ratios)

gotchas_discovered.description: Files are intentionally distributed across multiple subdirectories (min 10 subdirs) rather than flat structure
gotchas_discovered.impact: Simulates realistic directory hierarchies but complicates test file cleanup expectations

gotchas_discovered.description: Most timings rounded to 4 decimal places, but detection_time rounded to 6 places, and avg_time_per_file also 6 places
gotchas_discovered.impact: Minor inconsistency in output formatting that could confuse analysis scripts

approach_outcome.deliverable: Comprehensive deduplication benchmark script with configurable parameters and JSON output
key_achievements: Created modular benchmark functions for each deduplication operation
Implemented configurable file count, duplicate ratio, and hash algorithm
Added dry-run mode for testing without dependencies or file creation
Provided detailed timing metrics and duplicate statistics in output
Support for batch benchmarking at multiple file sizes
JSON output format for programmatic analysis and comparison
Proper error handling and validation for input parameters
approach_outcome.scope_completed: All required benchmarking functionality implemented and tested in first attempt

recommendations.suggestion: Add memory usage profiling (peak memory, memory per file) alongside timing metrics for complete performance picture
Extend hash algorithm choices to include sha1 and blake2b for more comprehensive comparative benchmarking
Add CSV export option in addition to JSON for easier plotting with external tools (matplotlib, gnuplot)
Support benchmarking with varied file sizes and types (binary, text, images) to test real-world scenarios
Add docstring with example performance baselines for the standard file counts (1000, 10000, 50000) as reference points
Standardize all timing precision to single decimal place value (recommend 4 places for all measurements)
